claims.text: Lactase deficiency: lactose-free diet controls Sx.
claims.quote: Carbohydrate malabsorption is readily controlled by avoiding dietary sugars that cannot be absorbed (ie, following a lactose-free diet in cases of lactase deficiency).

claims.text: Milk can be predigested w a commercial lactase; pretreated milk and dairy prod are available.
claims.quote: For symptomatic patients wishing to drink milk, lactose in milk can be predigested by the addition of a commercially prepared lactase. Pretreated milk and other dairy products are also available.

claims.text: Enzyme supp = an adjunct to dietary restriction, ⍉a substitute; pts must take calcium supp.
claims.quote: Enzyme supplements should be an adjunct to, not a substitute for, dietary restriction. Lactose-intolerant patients must take calcium supplements.
